solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Ruler's talk seems all right initially

definitions.note: read as 'Ruler is', the 's joining definition to wordplay

indicators.note: initially tells us to take the opening letter of each of the four words that follow

explanation.surface: A monarch's way of speaking starts off sounding perfectly acceptable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ruler's' is 'Ruler is': the apostrophe-s is a link, and 'initially' takes the first letters of talk, seems, all, right.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsar was the emperor of Russia, an absolute monarch.

clue.text: Saucy dance?

parts.note: a dance whose name is also that of a spicy Mexican sauce, so it is 'saucy' in a literal way

explanation.surface: A risqué, flirtatious dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saucy' suggests cheeky, but here it means 'of sauce': the Latin dance shares its name with a tomato-and-chilli dip.
explanation.definitionFit: This lively Latin American ballroom style shares its name with the Mexican chilli condiment.

clue.text: Note your rival — somehow radically different

indicators.note: somehow says these letters come together in some other, unspecified order

explanation.surface: A memo to a competitor, which turns out quite unlike what was expected.
explanation.definitionFit: Something revolutionary marks a complete break with what came before, a drastic change.

clue.text: A court visit upset campaigner

parts.note: CT is the standard abbreviation for court, as in street names

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and jumbled, so the letters of visit are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone protesting has their trip to the law courts thrown into disarray.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A court visit upset' tempts you to scramble all eleven letters, but only the last word is shuffled by 'upset'.
explanation.definitionFit: An activist works energetically for a political or social cause, i.e. a campaigner.

clue.text: Irritate using a word of refusal in New York

indicators.note: in places the word of refusal inside the abbreviation for the city

parts.note: no is the word we say when refusing

explanation.surface: Annoying people in New York by always saying no.
explanation.definitionFit: To annoy someone is to irk or vex them, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Poles in characteristic passage

indicators.note: in puts the two poles inside the word for characteristic

parts.note: a trait is a characteristic feature
N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: Polish people show a typical way through something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poles' looks like the nationality but means the magnetic poles N and S, which go 'in' TRAIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Transit is the act of passing through or across, i.e. a passage.

clue.text: US politician's weakness over gift I'd put in

definitions.note: read as 'US politician is', the 's a link

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: a vice is a moral weakness

indicators.note: put in says the short word is inserted into the gift word

parts.note: a present is a gift
taken as written, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: An American official's failing outweighs a present he slipped in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'US politician's' is read as 'US politician is'; 'put in' signals insertion and 'over' means placed first in a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The vice president is the second-highest elected official in the American executive branch.

clue.text: Special fuel, I hesitate to say, that's given away too much

parts.note: oil is a fuel
er is the sound one makes when hesitating

explanation.surface: Someone admits, hesitantly, that their talk of special fuel revealed too much.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoiler reveals a plot twist or ending prematurely, giving away information the audience wanted kept hidden.

clue.text: Country lads love Niamh's clothes

indicators.note: clothes is a verb here: the words dress, i.e. cover, the answer inside them

explanation.surface: A nation where young men adore an Irish girl's outfits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothes' looks like a noun but is the verb: the letters are hidden in ladS LOVE NIAmh's. Niamh is an Irish girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Slovenia is a small central European nation, formerly part of Yugoslavia.

clue.text: Reduce church work

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Cutting back on church labour.
explanation.definitionFit: To chop something, such as a budget, is to cut it back sharply.

clue.text: Grain, local, the French buy finally

parts.note: in Britain the local is one's neighbourhood pub, a bar
le is French for the

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of the word buy

explanation.surface: A shopping list: grain, local produce, and finally French goods to buy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'local' is British slang for the nearby pub, hence BAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Barley is a cereal crop whose seeds are used in brewing and food.

clue.text: Vehicle, one held in reserve, coming up

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: a sub, or substitute, is a player kept in reserve

explanation.surface: A spare vehicle kept in reserve arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' reverses SUB in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A bus is a large road passenger vehicle.

clue.text: In flexible way making provision

definitions.meaning: as a noun, ... is provision; to ... is to provide

explanation.surface: Arranging things adaptably when providing for needs.
explanation.walkthrough: The rarer sense is the adverb from supple, pronounced SUP-lee rather than sup-PLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Supply means providing what is needed; separately, it is an adverbial form of supple, meaning pliantly.

clue.text: Modern territory frequently linked with courage

parts.note: a state is a territory with its own government
oft is an old word for often, frequently
heart means courage, as in 'take heart'

explanation.surface: A contemporary region often associated with bravery.
explanation.definitionFit: Something state-of-the-art uses the latest technology, i.e. is up-to-date.

clue.text: After ex moves, having no liability to Revenue

indicators.note: moves says the letters shift about into a new order

explanation.surface: Once a former partner relocates, there is no longer any tax to pay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moves' rearranges AFTER EX. The Revenue is the UK tax authority.
explanation.definitionFit: Tax-free income is exempt from taxation, so nothing is owed to the tax authorities.

clue.text: Keep an eye on poetry in Old English

indicators.note: in puts the poetry word inside the abbreviation

parts.note: verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Supervise some poetry written in Old English.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversee is to supervise or watch over something.

clue.text: Draw neckwear item

definitions.meaning: a drawn game, with equal scores
a strip of cloth worn knotted at the neck

explanation.surface: Sketch a piece of neckwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' looks like the verb to sketch, but it is a noun: a game with no winner.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie is both a level result in a contest and a necktie.

clue.text: Reveal contents of text by model

indicators.note: contents of takes the inner letters of the word, without its first and last

parts.note: to model is to pose, as for an artist

explanation.surface: A model discloses what was in a message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contents of' takes EX from tEXt; 'by' just places it beside POSE.
explanation.definitionFit: To expose something is to uncover or make it public.

clue.text: Idiosyncrasy of returning book unopened

indicators.note: returning means the little word of is read backwards
unopened means the book loses its opening letter

parts.note: the Bible is the book

explanation.surface: A quirk of taking back a book without ever reading it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns OF into FO; 'unopened' removes the B of BIBLE, leaving IBLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A foible is a minor weakness or eccentricity in someone's character, a quirk.

clue.text: Contrive dishonest outcome of snooker game

definitions.meaning: to rig evidence so an innocent person is found guilty
in snooker, a ... is a single game

explanation.surface: Rig the result of a snooker match.
explanation.definitionFit: Frame means both to set someone up falsely and one game of a snooker match.

clue.text: Commit to memory name of king, northern

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's tragic king

explanation.surface: Memorise the name of a king from the north.
explanation.definitionFit: To learn something by heart is to memorise it.

clue.text: Song, popular, I adapted, in part

indicators.note: in part says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A popular song, which I arranged, at least in part.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo vocal piece in an opera.

clue.text: Long-distance traveller, name, international players recalled

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the combined letters are read in reverse

parts.note: taken as written
caps are players selected for national teams, each appearance earning a cap

explanation.surface: A far-travelled figure names the national players brought back into the squad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' reverses NAMECAPS. 'Long-distance traveller' is a whimsical description of an astronaut.
explanation.definitionFit: A spaceman journeys into outer space, about as far as any traveller goes.

clue.text: Both sides in the Rugby like nice fabric material

indicators.note: both sides means the first and last letters of each of the four words

explanation.surface: Rugby players on both teams admire a pleasant cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking first and last letters gives TE RY LE NE.
explanation.definitionFit: Terylene is a British brand name for a polyester fibre used in clothing.

clue.text: Fish aunt prepared

indicators.note: prepared, like food made ready, signals the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A relative cooks fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuna is a large oily sea fish, often tinned.
